summary.name: Looka
summary.one_liner: Looka is an AI-powered web platform for designing a logo and building a brand identity with matching marketing materials.
use_cases: create a logo for a new business
build a brand kit with colors and fonts
make social media profile and cover images
generate logo files for print and web
summary.what_it_does: Looka uses AI to generate logo mockups from user input, and lets users change colors, symbols, and sizing in an editor. Logo files are offered in SVG, PNG, EPS, and PDF formats, with black-and-white, color, and transparent background variations. The Brand Kit uses the chosen logo, colors, and fonts to create branded materials such as business cards, social profile images, email signatures, invoices, and flyers, drawing on 300+ templates. The page also mentions logo mockups on products like T-shirts and pens, a "Getting Started" brand guide, and live chat and email customer support.
notable: AI-generated logo mockups with an in-browser editor
Brand Kit that applies a logo's colors and fonts to 300+ templates
Logo files in SVG, PNG, EPS, and PDF with multiple background variations
caveats: Page says 'Get started for free' but full file access and some features likely require payment; the page does not state specific plan prices
Access to over $3,000 in partner offers is listed as a Brand Kit perk; terms are not stated
